Package guiLessonEditor

package guiLessonEditor

The guiLessonEditor package holds the page used both to record a new lesson and to edit an existing one. One page serves both, because the fields and the rules are the same; the title of the page and the Save action differ.

ViewLessonEditor builds the form, with a character counter under each field; ControllerLessonEditor reads the fields when Save Lesson or Cancel is pressed and reports a refused field in a ValidationAlert; ModelLessonEditor builds the lesson, checks ownership, and stores it through entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList.

Contributor stories implemented here: CS-1 (create, with the contributor taken from the logged in user, never typed), CS-7 (update), CS-9 (only the contributor may update), and the on-screen side of CS-10 and CS-11 (a refused field is named).
